exposure: Mechanical circulatory support (MCS) for cardiogenic shock (CS)
cohort: The study included eleven peripartum patients who experienced cardiogenic shock requiring mechanical circulatory support between 2012 and 2023 at a single center.
finding: Mechanical circulatory support in severe cardiogenic shock cases during the peripartum period, although rare, is associated with favorable outcomes and high recovery rates, suggesting MCS/LVAD may be favored over transplant.
mod_finding: 73% of patients underwent a caesarian-section for delivery, but no specific findings related to mode of birth outcomes were presented.
